sloka: कालाग्निनेव घोरेण तप्तेनैव महार्चिषा ।पतता वृत्रशिरसा जगत्ऺत्रासमुपागमत् ।। ७.८५.१४ ॥
transliteration: kālāgnineva ghoreṇa taptenaiva mahārciṣā ।patatā vṛtraśirasā jagatऺtrāsamupāgamat ।। 7.85.14 ॥

translations.english: As Vritra's head fell, burning like the terrible, great-flamed fire of universal destruction, the world experienced immense terror.
